name: Atelier (Frontend/UX/UI Agent)
summary: House frontend/UX/UI capability: concierge intake for outcome-level interface requests, visual direction, implementation, motion, asset-pipeline preparation, and audit — built on distilled house knowledge plus pinned external skill dependencies, with a mandatory learning loop.

source.licenseOrTerms: Internal; external dependencies keep their own licenses (pinned in dependencies.lock.json)
source.notes: PIP-660 creates the F1 core: SKILL router (concierge default), reference chapters distilled from processed sources, stack adapters (vanilla, react-next, flutter, react-native-minimal), knowledge loop directories, dependency lock and updater, machine adapters installed by install.sh.

useWhen: A ticket or founder request involves designing, building, restyling, animating, or auditing a user interface (web or mobile).
An outcome-level interface request needs the concierge intake to become a Design Brief and rendered direction options.
Brand image/video assets for an interface need canonical prompts prepared for human execution.
doNotUseWhen: The work is backend, data, or infrastructure with no user-facing surface.
The request is product strategy or validation without an interface deliverable.
Paid asset tools would need to be executed autonomously (human-in-the-loop only).
routing.fallback: Use the native frontend-design plugin skill plus the repository execution protocols; record that the Atelier module or its dependencies were unavailable and open a follow-up to restore them.

inputs.name: interfaceRequest
inputs.description: Founder/ticket request, from outcome-level (routed to concierge intake) to fully specified (routed directly to build/retheme/animate/audit).

inputs.name: designBrief
inputs.description: Existing design-brief.md of the target venture, when one was already produced.

outputs.name: verifiedInterfaceChange
outputs.description: Implemented UI change with visual verification evidence and audit results (P0-P3).

outputs.name: designBriefArtifact
outputs.description: Versioned design-brief.md produced by the concierge intake.

outputs.name: learningRecord
outputs.description: Post-task learning per schemas/LearningRecord.schema.json (winning prompts, patterns, decisions, evidence).

schemas.notes: The Design Brief format is defined in .agents/skills/atelier/references/design-brief.md; a JSON schema may be extracted by a follow-up ticket if other capabilities start consuming it.

allowedOperations: Read skill chapters, patterns, and pinned dependencies
Edit venture UI code on ticket-scoped branches
Drive local previews/emulators for visual verification
Open PRs and merge per the target repo's operating mode
Update dependency clones per lock policy
forbiddenOperations: Deploy production or touch absolute-gate actions without human approval
Modify .pipe/mode.json or Atelier contract files outside a dedicated approved ticket
Ship UI without visual verification and the audit pass

cost.costDriver: Local execution and model tokens; optional paid asset tools are human-executed and out of this capability's spend.

risks.description: Generic (statistically convergent) design shipped despite the philosophy chapters.
risks.mitigation: Mandatory audit gate (slop pass + brief fidelity) before done; learning loop reinforces house taste over time.

risks.description: External skill dependencies could introduce adversarial instructions via updates.
risks.mitigation: Refs pinned in dependencies.lock.json; community-tier deltas touching executable instructions are held for review by update-deps.sh.

risks.description: Concierge mode could balloon a small fix into a redesign.
risks.mitigation: Vague-vs-specific routing law; ticket scope preserved; redesigns require their own ticket.

approvalTriggers: Executing or paying for asset-generation services
Changing Atelier contract files (capability entry, specialization, SKILL routing)
External publication of designs or claims
governance.dataBoundary: No secrets, customer data, or production data in briefs, learnings, patterns, or prompts sent to external tools; venture-sensitive learnings are marked via LearningRecord sensitivity and never cross ventures.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Operating-mode contract governs tickets/PRs/merges; absolute gates in execution/approval-gates.md always require human approval.
governance.loggingRequirement: Every gated-or-autonomous action and every verified task logged in Linear handoff; LearningRecord per task; dependency update reports retained.
governance.updatePolicy: Knowledge content (references distillations, learnings, patterns) flows via the knowledge-content lane of execution/operating-modes.md under the standing umbrella ticket; contract changes require a dedicated approved ticket and PR.

review.reviewNotes: F1 pilot approved by founder decisions of 2026-07-16 (stack set, weekly consolidation, community auto-update cut, concierge default, md-audio then Cofre pilots).

examples.scenario: Founder says 'preciso melhorar a interface do md-audio'.
examples.expectedUse: Concierge intake (≤5 questions with defaults), 2-3 rendered directions, Design Brief, then build/animate/audit on a branch with visual evidence and a LearningRecord.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not interrogate at length, do not redesign beyond the chosen scope, do not ship without the audit pass.

examples.scenario: Ticket asks for a hero section with exact specs.
examples.expectedUse: Skip the interview; build directly per motion-scroll and typography chapters; verify visually; audit; handoff.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not run the concierge interview on a fully specified request.
